title: House set to discuss amendments to proposed 2027 budget

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Lawmakers will publicly discuss amendments to the proposed P7.2-trillion 2027 national budget, as the House of Representatives is set to take up the budget bill for plenary discussions on Tuesday.
